# UIToggleComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Checkbox of a script UI with a label; the callback runs when the player switches it.

## Methods

### getLabel {#getlabel}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — text next to the switch

:::

### getColor {#getcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — color of the text, as `0xRRGGBB`

:::

### getAlpha {#getalpha}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — opacity of the switch, 0 to 1

:::

### getTextAlpha {#gettextalpha}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — opacity of the text, 0 to 1

:::

### isTextShadow {#istextshadow}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the text has a shadow

:::

### getValue {#getvalue}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the switch is on

:::

### label {#label}

::: member

Changes the text next to the switch.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text |

**Returns** [`UIToggleComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIToggleComponent) — this toggle

### color {#color}

::: member

Sets the color of the text; the switch uses the Scram theme color.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` |

**Returns** [`UIToggleComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIToggleComponent) — this toggle

:::

### alpha {#alpha}

::: member

Sets the opacity of the switch.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | opacity, 0 (invisible) to 1 (opaque) |

**Returns** [`UIToggleComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIToggleComponent) — this toggle

:::

### textAlpha {#textalpha}

::: member

Sets the opacity of the text; only 0 (invisible) and 1 (opaque) are possible, as the value is a whole number.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpha` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 or 1 |

**Returns** [`UIToggleComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIToggleComponent) — this toggle

:::

::: member

| --- | --- | --- |

### value {#value}

::: member

Switches it on or off without calling the callback.

| Parameter | Type | Description |

| `value` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | whether the switch is on |
